## Upload a room photo and instantly preview AI redesigns

 

 

ImagineMyHouse lets you visualize home renovations by generating photorealistic redesigns from a single photo. Upload a picture of any room, exterior, or yard, choose a style or use Auto, then compare multiple looks in seconds. The platform supports interior, kitchen, bathroom, exterior, and landscape concepts, plus sketch-to-render workflows. Download high-resolution results without watermarks and use built-in tools for virtual staging, decluttering, and custom edits to plan with confidence.

## Turn TV breaks and daily pauses into quick movement bursts

 

 

BreakMoves turns commercial breaks and everyday pauses into quick chances to move. The app listens for TV ad breaks, then cues you with short, space-friendly stretches or exercises so you build consistency without carving out extra time. Use TV Mode to move during commercials, Nudge Mode for gentle reminders on your schedule, or Move Now to start anytime. Skip the gym and equipment, fit motion into your routine, and feel better while keeping the life you already enjoy.

 Thomas Orton

## Plan, generate, and edit complete AI videos in one workflow

 

VlogMe helps you turn an idea, script, image, audio file, or existing clip into a complete video. Its AI Director prepares a script and scene plan. Then, you can generate or transform each scene, add voice, music, and captions, edit the sequence, and export the finished video. VlogMe also includes image creation, talking avatars, voice tools, and social publishing.

title: Dividend Stacker
body:
Dividend Stacker: Track high-yield ETF payouts and plan | BetaList

## Track high-yield ETF payouts and plan dividend income with real data

Dividend Stacker helps dividend investors research high-yield ETFs and plan income with data-driven tools. It shows estimated next distributions, full payout histories, and total-return numbers for families like YieldMax, Roundhill, NEOS, Defiance, and REX Shares. Use calculators to project monthly income, compare funds side by side, and measure actual results with and without reinvestment. Explore dividend stocks and ETFs to know when you get paid and what $10,000 could have returned.

title: Halv
body:
Halv: Make your AI coding plan last twice as long | BetaList

## Make your AI coding plan last twice as long

 

 

 

 

 

Every turn, coding agents resend files, diffs, instructions, and logs they have already seen. Halv removes that wasted context locally before each request reaches the model. You can keep the same CLI, login, model, and subscriptions for Claude Code, Codex, Kimi, and GLM while getting far more work from your plan. Halv also includes split terminals, multi-agent workflows, local sandboxing, a Crux code index, command filtering, and a live savings meter with a receipt for every answer.

title: Linksight
body:
LinkSight: Plan RF line-of-sight links and Fresnel zones | BetaList

## Plan RF line-of-sight links and Fresnel zones instantly on the go

 

 

 

 

 

 

LinkSight helps you plan wireless links anywhere with precise line-of-sight and Fresnel zone analysis. It uses global topography, adjustable mast heights, and custom frequencies to validate point-to-point paths, estimate tower needs, and confirm clearances before fieldwork. You can generate professional PDF reports, drop GPS-accurate pins, and view live metrics for quick decisions. Whether for WISP, LoRa, UAV, or amateur radio, it puts RF planning in your pocket.

 Jorge Muñoz

Auto-Scheduler helps you stop deciding when to do tasks by automatically booking them into open time around your existing calendar events.
